unit: complete Tank War game; one technical reference at the first same-state local action difference
source: Private labels index original raw games, requests, replies, states, attempts, and event logs
label_provenance: screened intervention manifest plus same-state raw-state, request, selected action, and command comparison
annotation_status: machine evidence only; outside human reviews have not been linked to these sample IDs
blind_test: 40 earlier collected games were frozen separately before any v2 System 0 answer; same-family follow-up only
limitations: One sustained fault family per layer; this is not a family-transfer test.
The harness strategy setting is used in observation and plan revalidation; its functional boundary is mixed.
A local change does not prove that it caused the whole-game loss.
Previously collected games may have appeared in development; do not claim a fresh blind test.
